labels: Nansen Environmental and Remote Sensing Center
Stiftelsen Nansen Senter For Miljö OG Fjernmåling
description: The Nansen Environmental and Remote Sensing Center (NERSC) is an independent, non-profit research foundation located in Bergen, Norway, and affiliated with the University of Bergen. Founded in honor of polar explorer Fridtjof Nansen, the center specialises in marine, cryospheric, atmospheric, and climate science, with a primary geographic focus on high latitudes and the Arctic. It pioneers Earth system research by integrating satellite remote sensing, field observations, data assimilation, and numerical modeling to understand global change. Additionally, NERSC contributes significantly to national and European marine forecasting services, as well as major international bodies such as the IPCC.
